# NEIRO Payment Network (NPN)

> Solana transactions with gas paid in NEIRO. Independent Kora operators supply SOL and receive NEIRO. Clients discover signed terms onchain and call operators directly; no router is required.

## Choose one starting point

- [Human: choose how to run an operator and copy the agent brief](https://github.com/bropump/neiro-payment-network#set-up-your-operator)
- [Agent running an operator: AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bropump/neiro-payment-network/main/AGENTS.md) — the single setup procedure, including required evidence for completion.
- [Client / builder: BUILD-WITH-NEIRO.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bropump/neiro-payment-network/main/docs/BUILD-WITH-NEIRO.md) — use an existing operator with your wallet or application. No operator installation required.

This file is an index. Follow your selected procedure; open references when it links to them.
